title: Private operator bootstrap provider fragment
description: At most 8 KiB at provider-material.json. Same existing material format and field names; selected public service choices determine required external fields before effects. Omit credentials for bundled providers. Every mixed/external fragment supplies original storageUseUntil; fully bundled installation needs no fragment. Installer setup tokens, observed identities and registry configuration are forbidden here. The completed/pending retained seed uses initial-bootstrap-material.schema.json instead.
